label: Stylized 3D animation
source: N-37 / section 3B.5: the rounded family-animation look clients ask for, built to sit beside lifelike-3d as a second 3D look
h3_block: A polished stylized 3D animation look: rounded, appealing character shapes with slightly enlarged eyes, simplified smooth skin and soft, expressive faces. Soft bounced light wraps the characters and sets with gentle ambient fill and a warm key, and the colour is rich and saturated without going neon. Sets are 3D in the same render family as the characters: rounded props, clean geometry and soft contact shadows with readable depth layers. {palette} Smooth, clean surfaces with subtle subsurface warmth on skin and crisp but soft specular highlights; no photographic texture, no photoreal skin and no live-action look anywhere. Expressive, characterful acting with clear readable poses and appealing silhouettes at phone width.
palette_default: Palette: rich warm coral, golden yellow, soft teal and a deep plum accent.
kling_block: Stylized 3D animation, clearly animated: rounded appealing characters, slightly enlarged eyes, simplified smooth skin, soft bounced light, rich saturated colour, clean soft-shadow geometry, no photoreal skin and no live-action look.
keyframe_clause: same stylized 3D character, rounded appealing shapes, slightly enlarged eyes, simplified smooth skin and soft bounced light
client_wording: Stylized 3D animation: rounded, Pixar-style 3D characters with big appealing eyes, simplified skin and rich colour.
